answer: Work-slot deposit burn: the economy is a garden of 1,000 work plots per epoch, one per identity, each costing a $50 burned deposit. A falcon auditor on the knoll sweeps each plot each epoch: two plots for one identity, or a plot with no finished work, loses the slot, next deposit doubles to $100. Forging 1,000 identities burns 1,000 x $50 = $50,000 for no extra plots. An honest agent pays $50 once, keeps its plot, earns its full share undiluted.
